rows.sourceIdentity: One ordinary barline, proposed twice through adjacent seed columns. Upper fit is a slur crest at the line; lower fit is a staff/barline cross. No shared musical shaft.

Staff lines intersecting the terminal double line. Thick intersections impersonate filled heads.
First interval has two bare staff/barline crosses; second has a staff-line endpoint and a broken staff-end corner at the terminal line. The hollow fit is an open source corner, not a notehead.
Two ordinary barlines intersect separate slur arcs. Three fits classify tiny thick arc/shaft overlaps as filled heads; one open corner is classified hollow.
